description: Evidence-first browser inspection contract. This contract defines a workflow; it does not itself capture or inspect screenshots.

findingSchema.evidence: Screenshot path, DOM locator, measured value or reproducible interaction.

rules: Never claim a screenshot was captured unless a browser run produced it.
Never claim a visual review from a static HTML or CSS scan.
Record the exact viewport and route for every rendered finding.
Re-run the affected viewport after a correction.
Keep accessibility automation, visual model review and human approval as separate evidence types.
Do not publish a single quality score without dimension-level findings and evidence.
